The ⟦0⟧, included in ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ is one of the most complex series of ⟦3⟧ in the game, and it is the main theme of ⟦4⟧. It includes several files to simulate the different factions and factors of the war, as it is the first clash among several factions, preeminently the Comintern and the Axis. However, it also involves neutral countries such as ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ (usually involved on the Nationalist side) and, obviously, Spain. From the democratic side, ⟦7⟧ also has a few options to take sides.

In historical mode it is the first victory for the Fascist countries, and the first defeat of the Soviets, as ⟦0⟧ is the main choice of the AI. For modders, especially those involved in ⟦1⟧ it is one of the most complex layouts, as it includes lots of lines of code, flags, decisions, events, and national focuses.
⟦0⟧ National Focus (common/national_focus/Portugal.txt) includes the sub-branches ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧, which allow involvement in the Spanish Civil War and ideology changes.

Another ⟦0⟧ effect that includes the different leaders and commanders of the Spanish Civil War. It is divided between the different factions. Nationalist Leaders: José Antonio Primo de Rivera, which will be demoted hastily after the war and Manuel Fal Conde, who will lead the Carlist uprising. Republican Leaders: Niceto Alcalá-Zamora, which will be replaced after the elections, and José Díaz, who will lead the communist party. Nationalist land commanders: Juan Yagüe, Gonzalo Queipo de Llano, Mohamed Meziane, Francisco Franco, Emilio Mola and Agustín Muñoz Grandes. Republican commanders:José Miaja, Vicente Rojo Lluch, José Asensio Torrado, Valentín González, Juan Modesto and Antonio Cordón García Anarchist land commander: János Gálicz. Carlist land commanders: Miguel Cabanellas, José Enrique Varela and José Millán Astray.
⟦0⟧: ⟦1⟧, which will be demoted hastily after the war and ⟦2⟧, who will lead the ⟦3⟧ uprising.
